title: Bouchaud-Inspired Firm Fragility
research_question: Can endogenous balance-sheet fragility amplify unemployment, inflation and monetary-policy shocks?
mechanisms: Heterogeneous firm balance sheets, borrowing and default
Entry and exit with asset/liability reconciliation
Calvo pricing coupled to firm financial states
equilibrium_conditions_and_caveats: Keep Calvo as the baseline nominal rigidity; compare any alternative pricing model separately.
No double-counting firm-price adjustment or bank losses.
Explicit loan market, firm cash-flow and accounting closure.
comparators: baseline with no firm credit friction
acceptance_tests: Switch-off recovery and nonlinear response robustness

implementation.numerical_policy: Record equilibrium residuals, calibration, random seeds, tolerances and convergence tests.
